The three Corner Relief types at the corners of a flange on four edges, on the reported design of GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#614 (mitcad#2424; run by sheet-flange-corner-relief-reported-test.cmake, never committed): Sheet Rules t = 1, r = 1, K = 0.44 (BA = 0.72 pi), Bend Relief and Corner Relief Rectangular 1 mm; a 130 x 50 Sheet Face cut back to 126 x 46; one Flange of outer length 10, Inside, on its four edges (Corner Gap t). As saved, the rules have no flange_corner_relief, so the corners stay as before mitcad#2342: each bend ends 1/sqrt2 short of the tangent lines' inner corner J0, the round bend ends the report saw. Editing the rules sets the flag: Tear lets the bends meet at J0; Rectangular 1 mm ends each bend 1 mm short of J0 and takes a 1 mm square from the face's corner, 4 (1 + 2 BA) less flat area than Tear; Round 1 mm cuts a disc of diameter 1 centred at J0, 3 pi / 4 less than Tear. Every flat pattern is valid.
As saved (no flag): the bends end 1/sqrt2 short of J0.
Rectangular 1 mm, the rules edited (the flag set).
Tear: the bends meet at each J0.
